name: baseline (current build)
notes: The current build as audited on 29 Sep 2026: terminal skin, case on, 58 dp movement keys, default prefs. Phone and tablet screens from the Java-derived models (android/*.json); 915x412, 844x390, their portrait pairs, 1366x768 (touch) and 1920x1080 (mouse) from the live web captures. Long rest is swipe-revealed in the REST slot ("behind": "rest"). Pop-ups are the Android models' (flick nodes, pad-centre radial, context candidates, count-chip rows); the web captures have none. "decor" is the case (wells, hood, deck and key-row wells): drawn, but counted as void.

896x443.source: audit android/landscape.json 896x443, 58 dp keys, case on, scale 1

controls.label: PIN 1 (COMBAT point 0; portrait calls it QUIVER)
PIN 2 (COMBAT point 1; portrait calls it FIRE)
FLICK key (retired 3rd point; ZAP in the portrait comment)

popups.label: flick_node0: flick UP node (Kick ^D by default)
restchips: REST / LONG REST count chips
chips_strip0: count chips over LOOK (when counted)
chips_strip1: count chips over CONTEXT (when counted)
